caveat: One training seed and synthetic map. Confirmation uses independent evaluation seeds but is not independent training replication or cross-map generalization. Descriptive standard errors are not confidence intervals. All outcomes retained.

paired_comparison.caveat: Descriptive sample standard error across scenario seeds, not a confidence interval or proof of improvement. Both seats of a seed are correlated; incomplete pairs are excluded.
paired_comparison.unit: scenario seed; mean of BLUE and RED own-score deltas

sequence: Independent heldout seed confirmation requested after positive 32-pair result; same trained checkpoint, no additional training or configuration changes.
